name: George’s Shoe Repair
tagline:
Good shoes deserve
a second life.
about: A cobbler on Lee Highway in Fairfax. Customers praise George’s craftsmanship, reasonable prices, and honest advice on whether a resole, a topper, or a new heel is the right fix.
locationNote: Drop-off shop · Call for turnaround times

reviews.author: Chuck B.
reviews.text: George does fantastic work, he’s a real craftsman. Shoes were returned looking great

reviews.author: Amanda M.
reviews.text: He fixed three pairs of my shoes for a reasonable price, including my beloved black boots that needed a refresh. Very friendly guy who clearly knows his craft.

reviews.author: R. Adam C.
reviews.text: I would recommend this gentleman to anyone looking for an honest business.
